regime: Fed hike being priced, with silver under extra stress and the oil shock still on
takeaway: The Fed held rates in a 10-2 vote with two officials wanting a hike, and markets now put the odds of a December hike above 80%. Gold ended flat near $4,057 while silver fell about 1% and the gold/silver ratio rose above 75.5; the 10-year yield rose back above 5% as the 2-year slipped. Stocks edged up for a third day, but Alphabet's 10% after-hours drop and Thursday's GDP and inflation data can change this picture quickly.
